result.title: You Only Encode Once: Sub-Pixel-Shifted Frames for Arbitrary-Scale Remote Sensing Super-Resolution with 2D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) of remote sensing images remains challenging due to the limited high-frequency information in a single low-resolution (LR) observation. While multi-frame SR can exploit complementary sub-pixel information, existing approaches often require real multi-frame training sequences and repeated feature encoding, increasing data acquisition demands and computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose SPS-GS (Sub-Pixel-Shifted Gaussian Splatting), an encode-once framework that learns from multi-phase LR observations synthesized from individual high-resolution images, without requiring real multi-frame training sequences. Specifically, Phase-Coherent Aliasing Demodulation (PCAD) exploits shift-dependent aliasing through Fourier-based alignment, phase-aware residual fusion, and least-squares aliasing estimation, enabling multi-frame information to be integrated before a single deep encoding pass. Gaussian Projection Alignment (GPA) then iteratively refines Gaussian centers and colors using multi-observation back-projection to promote observation consistency. The refined Gaussians support continuous rendering at arbitrary scales. Extensive experiments on five remote sensing datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction performance against single-image and multi-frame SR baselines, while maintaining competitive inference efficiency at common scales. The code will be publicly released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPS-GS，一种「只编码一次」的遥感任意尺度超分框架：用单幅高分辨率图合成多相位低分辨率观测，先经傅里叶对齐与相位感知残差融合把多帧信息合并，再做一次深度编码，并以多观测反投影迭代精化 2D 高斯中心与颜色以支持任意尺度渲染。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「编码前融合多帧互补信息、避免重复编码」的路线可供核查是否能降低视觉细节进入内部状态的编码成本，而反投影式高斯状态精化也可能为多证据整合与状态更新提供线索，但需确认其表示是否可服务推理而非仅重建。
